correctness.rationale: The odd-prime product bound gives sigma(n)/n <=2304/1155<2. For n=2pqr the deficit D=(3p+3q+3-pq)r+3(p+1)(q+1) must be positive; monotonicity and divisor-coefficient comparisons force p in {3,5,7}, the stated finite q lists and r<=167. Exhaustion of all 399 ordered prime triples within these proven necessary bounds checked each of 105 unordered pairs of 15 distinct proper divisors. All 15 values and their uniqueness follow; the finite enumeration is exhaustive only because the analytic cutoff is proved.
